description.p: Sygnature is a cross-platform, self-custody cryptocoin wallet for individuals and groups. Shared wallets combine multi-signature approval with multi-party computation (MPC), allowing a chosen threshold of participants to authorize payments together without ever assembling the complete private key. Each participant keeps a private signing share on their own device, while ElectrumX keeps wallet balances and transactions in sync. Personal and watch-only wallets are supported too.
